title: Orchard and Postcard
author: Wren Whitlock
blurb: Sebastian Delacroix, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the bakery lease runs out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
